scope: Static art geometry only; no runtime binding or gameplay validation is implied.

coordinateSpaces.source: Original generated image pixels; unchanged source resolution and SHA.
coordinateSpaces.crop: Source crop rectangle [x,y,width,height], including documented transparent gutter.
coordinateSpaces.sprite: Exported PNG pixels; anchor belongs to this coordinate system.
coordinateSpaces.rig: Independent assembly canvas pixels. Old rig sizes remain 448x640, 640x770, etc.
coordinateSpaces.scene: Logical preview pixels at 390x844 or 320x524. Uniform transform of rig.
coordinateSpaces.hit: Logical preview pixels, distinct from visible image bounds.

cropAndExportChecks: Source crop remains inside generated source.
Source and exported SHA-256 are computed from actual files.
PNG decodes; dimensions match manifest; actual transparent alpha exists except room.
Minimum 2px transparent gutter surrounds new sprites. Existing approved reusable boundary conditions are recorded individually.
No alpha>=128 pixel touches a transparent sprite outer border.
Object silhouette is complete. Padding alone is not evidence that clipped source pixels were restored.
Resize is uniform, with <=1 pixel rounding tolerance.
rigChecks: Rig canvas size, anchor, input, output, hitPolygon and contentClip have finite measured values.
Every layer asset ID resolves to one exported or reuse asset; no per-generation duplicate PNG.
Every layer rect [x,y,w,h] uses rig pixels and positive dimensions; width/height preserves sprite aspect ratio within rounding tolerance.
No new machine body is horizontally stretched to add lanes.
Working-head slot centers match visible physical apertures, and installed head count matches the preview configuration.
Inactive apertures use cover sprites and do not display finished products or active heads.
Layer order specifies body/back, each head/content sublayer and front occluder.
Products are clipped to each intended belt/bin/machine slot; front rails occlude products only where physically expected.
Input/output centerlines join across adjacent machine/belt/buffer modules without mirrored light direction or accidental geometric gaps.

requiredVisualCases: single old-batch job plus larger new-batch job
inspection: Three stations, two buffers and both input controls are recognizable.
Machine/buffer/input visible bounds do not substitute for hit regions.
Primary hit region bounding boxes are at least 44x44 logical pixels; first-generation inputs prefer 56x56 where layout permits.
Expanded station panel and safe areas do not cover required controls.
Tower layers never obscure product flow or interactive station silhouettes.
State semantics are not conveyed by color alone.

budgetChecks.generationUnion: sum bytes/dimensions for unique SHA-backed IDs in common + actual generation dependency set
budgetChecks.transitionUnion: common + old generation + next generation, counting shared sprites only once

compactReuseTransform.note: If QA compact256 is adopted, update sprite metadata and sprite anchor only; retain baseline rig coordinate canvas and logical layer rects.
compactReuseTransform.sourceRect: unchanged when optimizing an already-exported baseline PNG; provenance explicitly identifies that baseline PNG as input
compactReuseTransform.sourceProvenance: Keep original generated source reference as upstream provenance; do not pretend this derivative was directly generated.
